title: Load a metadata bundle
responsibility: Load or reuse one pinned metadata bundle into the authorized source context.

inputs.name: hubMetadata.context
inputs.description: Source context supplying the entries, identity, commit, repository, cache, source adapter, and metadata state used by the loader. Loading occurs only when source.rawMany exists and metadata is falsy.

outputs.name: hubMetadata
outputs.description: Resolves to undefined after the shared load completes and stores the bundle in context.metadata. It resolves immediately when context.metadata is truthy or context.source.rawMany is absent; a load rejection clears metadataPending and propagates.

errors.name: Metadata load error
errors.description: Rejects with the underlying thrown or rejected value from metadata path construction, cache access/deletion/write, source.rawMany, or bundle transformation/validation. A failed shared load clears metadataPending and propagates that value unchanged.
